headline: A-share headlines: US and China to hold a new round of economic and trade talks; CXMT announces official mass production of its fifth-generation technology platform; Iran has put ceasefire conditions to the US
summary: The US and China will hold a new round of economic and trade talks, according to a Chinese market briefing. The same briefing noted CXMT's fifth-generation technology platform entering mass production.
why: US-China trade talks shape tariffs, export controls and supply chains that affect global technology and manufacturing companies.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude
